ex_vivo_detail: The body contains a section titled 'Ex vivo biodistribution', but it describes harvesting organs from mice already dosed in vivo and gamma-counting them; no agent was applied to isolated tissue outside the body, so ex vivo was not listed as a study type.

concentration_time_figure.locator: Figure 4A (plasma concentration vs time); also Figure 2D and Figure 3E (PET-derived blood time-activity curves)
concentration_time_figure.caption_quote: (A) Time vs. blood concentration curves of Exendin-4 and Abextide after subcutaneous injection determined by a commercial EIA kit (n=4/group).
concentration_time_figure.note: Figure 4A plots blood concentration versus time after subcutaneous dosing measured by EIA. Figures 2D and 3E plot PET-derived blood %ID/g versus time after intravenous and subcutaneous injection of the radiolabeled analogs.

bioanalytical_method: Commercial Exendin-4 enzyme immunoassay (EIA) kit (Phoenix Biotech, USA) for plasma concentrations; PET imaging (Inveon small-animal scanner) and gamma counting (Packard) for radiolabeled analogs
bioanalytical_quote: Amount of Exendin-4 or Abextide in plasma was measured by commercial Exendin-4 EIA kits (Phoenix Biotech., USA).
bioanalytical_section: METHODS - Hypoglycemic efficacy and in vivo pharmacokinetics test of Abextide in db/db mice
notes: Discrepancy within the article: the Methods and Results place the pharmacokinetic study in db/db mice ('in vivo pharmacokinetics test of Abextide in db/db mice'), but the Table 1 caption reads 'after subcutaneous administration to SD rats'. The half-life, Cmax, Tmax and AUCinf values in Table 1 are therefore of uncertain species attribution; they are recorded here with the mouse attribution given in the Results text and this conflict flagged. Group size also conflicts: Methods state n = 3/group while the Figure 4A caption states n = 4/group. No amino acid sequence or SMILES is printed in the body for Exendin-4 or Abextide. Blood sampling times for the PK arm are given only as 'predetermined times'; the IPGTT time points were 0, 1, 2, 4, 6, 8, 12, 24, 48, 72, 96 h.
